title: Western Union prize text
body: A text from a Kingston number: you've won $500 in a Western Union promotion, verify your account with $30. The number is new and the grammar is off. This one is old. It still catches people.

choices.label: Risk the $30 — if it pays you're up $470.

title: Your bag got lifted at Papine Market
body: You went to Papine to buy stock. Someone lifted $120 from your bag while you were at the vegetable stalls. Miss Vida at the next stall says she saw a youth in a blue shirt but he's long gone.

choices.label: File a report with the constabulary.
Let it go. Waste of time.

title: UHWI sends you a bill
body: A letter from University Hospital. That chest infection you walked in with two weeks ago cost $280 to treat. No insurance. Payment is due in 30 days or the account goes to a collection agency.

title: Desmond isn't paying you back
body: Three months ago you lent Desmond $150 to cover his stall licence. He's been avoiding your calls. You saw him at Constant Spring Market on Wednesday — he crossed the street when he spotted you. The money isn't coming back.

choices.label: Write it off. That's on you for trusting.
Go to him directly and make a scene.
Get someone from the community to pressure him.

title: The jerk chicken setup lost money
body: You borrowed Miss Ida's pan and bought $80 in chicken and seasoning to sell at the community centre dance on Friday. The dance moved to Portmore at the last minute. You sold $30 of food before giving up. Down $50 and exhausted.

choices.label: Take the loss. Try again next weekend.
Sell the rest door to door Sunday morning.

title: Roof is leaking bad
body: The zinc over your room has been going since October. This week's rain made it real. A proper fix costs $200. The tape-and-plastic option costs $40. If you ignore it your things get ruined and Miss Brown downstairs gets angry.

choices.label: Move your things and ignore it.

title: Sibling is in hospital
body: Aunt Marcia calls at 7 a.m. Your sister had an accident coming home from night school. She's at Spanish Town Hospital. She needs $180 for the X-ray and medication. The nurse is waiting. Your sister is crying in the background.

choices.label: Send $100 — it's all you can spare.
Tell them to call the other relatives first.
